title: Black Light FTL Evidence Instance, Exploration, and Forensic Handoff Registry

authority.scope: Machine-readable evidence-instance authority for propulsion/transit archaeology. It records what was observed, where it was observed, how damage and provenance affect interpretation, and what may be exported to archaeology/forensic resolvers without inventing a transit family.
sourceOrder: Google Drive: The different lightspeed methods

subject.name: Unidentified Ar'nock Derelict
confirmedFacts: The subject is an unidentified damaged Ar'nock vessel stranded in deep space.
The operatives awakened in a biological fabrication and medical compartment aboard the vessel.
The vessel contains biological printers, medical systems, cultivated computation, environmental controls, storage, fabrication feedstock, damaged networks, and inaccessible compartments.
The vessel has no immediately readable name, registry, destination, or complete surviving historical explanation.
Ar'nock machinery includes biological fabrication, cultivated neural computation, flexible interfaces, vibration-based controls, and unfamiliar identity controls.
No surviving authority currently identifies the vessel's FTL family.

geometry.notes: Existence and function class are confirmed by the foundation archive; exact geometry is not established by that source.

observations.statement: The vessel contains damaged networks and cultivated computation.
observations.damageContext: Networks are explicitly damaged; surviving topology is not assumed complete.
observations.interpretation: Supports a need for damage-aware dependency tracing; does not discriminate among FTL families.

observations.damageContext: Species/civilization engineering basis is confirmed at broad scope; installation-specific transit implementation remains unknown.
observations.interpretation: Constrains machinery embodiment but cannot select a transit family.

observations.damageContext: Contents, number, dimensions, and functions of inaccessible compartments are unresolved.
observations.interpretation: Creates explicit unknown volume; it is not positive evidence for any missing transit component.

observations.statement: No immediately readable vessel name, registry, destination, or complete historical explanation is available.
observations.damageContext: Absence is limited to immediately readable information; it does not prove records never existed.
observations.interpretation: Prevents identity, manufacturer, mission, and transit-family attribution from metadata alone.

unknownVolumes.reasonUnknown: The foundation archive establishes inaccessible compartments but does not establish their count, positions, contents, geometry, or surviving services.
forbiddenUses: placing a preferred FTL component inside the volume as observed fact
counting the volume as support for a family hypothesis
treating absent survey evidence inside the volume as negative evidence

mathematics.observationWeight: W_o = R_o * D_o * P_o * S_o, where reliability, damage-adjusted detectability, provenance independence, and spatial specificity remain separately auditable in [0,1].
mathematics.negativeEvidenceAdmissibility: A^- = I * V * S * (1-D). Absence is family-discriminating only when instrument capability I, observed coverage V, expected marker survivability S, and non-destructive survival fraction (1-D) make the marker reasonably observable.
mathematics.provenanceIndependence: P_o = 1 / n_a for observations sharing one ultimate source ancestor unless a stronger correlation model is available. Repeated screens or translations do not multiply evidence.
mathematics.compartmentCompleteness: C_c = sum_k w_k q_k / sum_k w_k for measured geometry, service, residue, archive, damage, and access dimensions. C_c describes survey completeness, not confidence in a functional label.
mathematics.familyExportRule: E_f = {channel, statement, W_o, provenanceGroup, spatialRef, damageContext, familyLikelihoodVector, contradictions, sourceStatus}. Only resolveTransitForensics() may promote a family hypothesis.
mathematics.serviceContinuity: Q_e = O_e * S_e * T_e, where observation confidence O, survival estimate S, and trace completeness T determine whether a service edge is usable in dependency analysis.
mathematics.translationConfidence: C_tr = C_lex * C_sem * C_clock * C_context. Translation confidence cannot exceed the weakest required semantic/clock context for the claim being made.

compartmentCreation: Create a compartment instance only when a source, observation, or explicit scenario seed establishes a spatial volume.
Use neutral IDs before functional names unless a named source supplies the function.
Unknown geometry remains null/UNRESOLVED rather than being filled for presentation convenience.
A machinery object inherits the status of the observation that establishes it, not the confidence of a later functional hypothesis.
serviceNetwork: Never create a service edge because two rooms are adjacent in a map.
Observed, traced, derived, and proposed edges must remain distinguishable.
Destroyed or interrupted edges retain their former hypothesis only when evidence supports that history.
Power, thermal, nutrient, timing, data, field, structural, and maintenance layers remain separate.
telemetry: Preserve raw text or signal summary separately from translation and interpretation.
Every translated fragment records its ultimate source node and derivative ancestry.
Clock uncertainty is independent of semantic translation confidence.
A technical noun resembling a known FTL term cannot establish family identity without operator-consistent evidence.
progressiveDisclosure: Player-facing descriptions may reveal observations that have been earned without revealing GM-only family rankings.
A CANDIDATE_SET may be described through observed machinery and signatures without naming a preferred family.
Generated room titles must not leak a family classification that the evidence state has not promoted.

resolverContract.mutationRule: Every intervention that can change geometry, chemistry, biological viability, field residue, data state, or service topology must create an intervention record before post-action evidence is admitted.

provenance.generationRule: Generated evidence may specialize a scenario instance but may not promote DERIVED or PROPOSED content into setting canon. Every externally asserted claim retains source, status, transform, and ancestry.

canonGuards: The Ar'nock derelict FTL family remains UNRESOLVED.
Do not infer a transit family from biological construction, cultivated neural computation, flexible interfaces, vibration controls, or unfamiliar identity systems.
Do not treat Q-MAP as Quantum Phase Displacement unless a higher authority explicitly connects them.
Do not turn inaccessible volume into positive evidence for a missing component.
Do not turn an unobserved service edge into an observed one because it would make an installation diagram cleaner.
Do not invent exact compartment geometry, deck location, machinery count, capacity, Path level, T-tier, range, speed, manufacturer, inventor, mission, or date from the current foundation archive.
Do not count multiple displays or translated derivatives of one source node as independent evidence.
Do not use absence as contradiction without damage-adjusted detectability.
Do not erase investigator contamination, cutting, energization, healing, regrowth, relocation, or repair from evidence ancestry.
Do not equate a functional room hypothesis with historical room naming.
Do not allow player-facing prose to reveal a family conclusion that the authoritative evidence state has not earned.
Do not energize unknown machinery to commit-capable authority solely to improve classification.
Do not allow generated numeric coefficients to become setting-wide constants unless separately adopted as canon.
Do not let a later convenience description overwrite a raw observation; preserve both and link the transform.
